about_the_game:
The Season Pass includes the following content:
• Playable Character 1 - additional character
• Playable Character 2 - additional character
• Playable Character 3 - additional character
• Playable Character 4 - additional character
• 7-day Early Access for DLC characters
• Two-Type Soul Crystal Set 1
- Attack Soul Crystal (Light Scratch), Defense Soul Crystal (Endure)

*The DLC included in Season Pass will be available by 3/21/2026.
